summary: Immix Biopharma, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement for a follow-on offering of 16,778,524 shares of common stock at $8.94 per share, the May 20, 2026 closing price. The offering is expected to generate $141 million in net proceeds before expenses. Underwriters include Morgan Stanley and BofA Securities. This is a standard equity capital raise, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change.
